name: Cad Bane
bannerMiniatureIdeas: A wide-brimmed hat mounted on a holoprojector pedestal — Cad Bane's iconic gunslinger silhouette
Twin LL-30 blaster pistols crossed over a bounty puck hologram display
A holographic disguise matrix emitter flickering with a Neimoidian silhouette from the Naboo kidnapping plot
vehicleSuggestions: Xanadu Blood — Cad Bane's Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter from the Clone Wars
Justifier — Cad Bane's assault transport used during the Imperial era
Munificent-class star frigate — Trade Federation vessel loaned for the Jedi Temple holocron heist

factionTrait.name: Tactician Champion
factionTrait.text: A tactician moves the turn token +1 step when they make a claim action.

uniqueTraits.name: Decoy Payday
uniqueTraits.text: When a Holoprojector Decoy leaves the battlefield, Cad Bane may gain the boon of your choice.

ultimate.name: Rocket Boot Descent
ultimate.text: Place Cad Bane on a hex within range. Then move each enemy model within 2 hexes of him up to 2 hexes in the order of your choice.

plotSkills.name: Shift the Mark
plotSkills.text: Choose an empty objective hex within range. Place it on an empty non-objective hex within range.

plotSkills.name: Through the Decoy
plotSkills.text: Choose a hex within range containing one Holoprojector Decoy. Remove the Holoprojector Decoy and place Cad Bane in that hex.

plotSkills.name: Holo Scramble
plotSkills.text: Move a Holoprojector Decoy within range up to 3 hexes.

clashSkills.name: Through the Decoy
clashSkills.text: Choose a hex within range containing one Holoprojector Decoy. Remove the Holoprojector Decoy and place Cad Bane in that hex.

clashSkills.name: Stun Gauntlet
clashSkills.text: Hit Effect: Move target up to 1 hex.

clashSkills.name: Quick Draw Charge
clashSkills.text: Before the hit roll, move Cad Bane up to 1 hex towards the target.

traits.name: Sync the Projection
traits.text: Once per phase during the Holoprojector Decoys' activation, you may choose a boon on Cad Bane. The Holoprojector Decoys gain that boon.

plotSkills.name: Flicker and Reframe
plotSkills.text: You may place each Holoprojector Decoy in a hex up to 3 hexes from its current hex.

plotSkills.text: Hit Effect: Move target up to 1 hex.
